newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rubber falls in noon trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rubber falls in noon trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber prices fell in noon trading on Thursday on sluggish demand, traders said.
They said SIR20 was on offer at 48.50 U.S. cents/lb in Medan against Wednesday's close in Medan for June shipment and at 48.25 fob Palembang against 49.00.

"Traders tried to offer rubber at 48.50 in Palembang for June shipment last night, but nobody was interested," said one trader. "I think prices will continue to fall because demand is very low." Traders said rubber on offer at 48.00 fob Padang and at 47.75 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
Prices in Padang, Pontianak and Jambi earlier hovered at around 49.50-75 this week.
Traders said the market was dull because buyers seemed to be well-stocked.
"We just assume that buyers are well-stocked as they are not doing much purchasing," said another trader.
The market is closed on Friday for the Moslem Eid al-Adha celebration.
